name: The Bride They Feared, The Queen They Crowned
original_name: 他们曾畏惧的新娘，他们加冕的王后
overview: Bella Elmer's half-sister, Lisa Elmer, steals her wedding gift and marriage. Her fiancé wants to take Lisa as his main wife and Bella as his concubine. To change her fate, Bella volunteers to marry the 80-year-old King of Bexar. On her wedding night, she defends herself with a knife, only to realize that the bridegroom is Marcus Keagan, the god of war. From then on, Princess Bella and Prince Marcus join hands to quash their enemies and rule over their dominion. (Source: DramaBoxdb)
